candidates.title: Revanth Reddy reviews power crisis after BRS thermal plant inspection call
candidates.excerpt: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy convened a high‑level review on Wednesday amid a prolonged power shortage, directing officials to ensure full‑capacity generation at Yadadri Thermal Power Station before Dasara featival. With two units shut due to critically low coal stocks and farmers staging protests, the government has decided to source coal from Mahanadi Coalfields and Coal India to stabilise supply.

candidates.title: Bridge collapses across Palavaagu stream in Kothagudem, no casualties reported
candidates.excerpt: A bridge across the Palavaagu stream at Rajupet in Mulakalapalli mandal collapsed following a surge of floodwaters, disrupting traffic on the Paloncha-Dammapet road. While no casualties were reported, motorists faced inconvenience as police erected barricades and advised alternate routes.

candidates.title: At UNGA, Ukrainian President Zelenskyy calls Putin ‘Patient Zero’ of war
candidates.excerpt: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, addressing the UN General Assembly, urged global leaders to restrict Russia’s trade revenues to weaken its war effort. He accused President Vladimir Putin of perpetuating conflict, calling him “Patient Zero” of war.

candidates.title: EAM Jaishankar urges united push for UNSC reform
candidates.excerpt: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar urged countries impacted by the UN Security Council’s failures and slow reform process to unite for change. Chairing a meeting of the L.69 group with participation from Africa’s C-10, he stressed that delaying reforms perpetuates “historical injustice.”

candidates.title: HC directs police to preserve CCTV footage after advocates allege ill-treatment at station

candidates.title: TV actress held for Rs 5.5 lakh extortion in Chennai
candidates.excerpt: Chennai police arrested 28-year-old television actress Varshini Venkat for allegedly assaulting and extorting Rs 5.5 lakh from a stock trader under the guise of funding a short film. Venkat, along with accomplices, forced the victim to pay cash and bank transfers, later demanding an additional Rs 27 lakh.

candidates.title: Trial run held on KPHB–Waverock corridor for dedicated bus lane

The exercise, supported by transport and planning experts, also examined congestion along the JNTU–Biodiversity corridor.
